text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, when I went to eat ramen with 
Agnes Digital—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-This is the ramen shop of my dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hau! R-Rob Roy-san! Isn't seeing you at a 
ramen shop super rare...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Umm... page 257... Soy, sauce, ramen... 
here it is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... Um... Excuse meee...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Two orders of shio ramen coming right up!
choice_data_list: Looks like they didn't hear it.
Looks like they didn't hear it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mmh...!? Rob Roy is in a pinch...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, clerk, please take their order 
over there! It's the favor of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Wait, forever?! I-I'll be right over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Agnes Digital's assist, Zenno Rob Roy 
managed to order her ramen. However, this 
time...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I think it was extra pepper on that... 
Huh? It's not on the table...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I will deliver it right away...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *pat-pat-pat-pat*!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that just... Huh? There's 
pepper sitting here...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete, that it is! Please take 
your time and savor the ramen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ Rob Roy-san eating ramen... To 
stumble upon a scene like this, building 
up good karma really pays off~~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyowaaah?! Rob Roy-san...!! Eh, ah, um...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for helping me earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, e-eh, I-I'm so sowwy! Like, seriously, 
for butting in like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Not at all...! Thanks to you, I finally 
got to eat the ramen I've been dreaming 
of.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The scene where the protagonist Umamusume 
in this book eats ramen the night before a 
race... It was modeled after that shop 
from earlier."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that if I ate the same thing, 
maybe I could run like the protagonist 
too... ...Not that it's anything more than 
wishful thinking, though."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ......Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, this is the one thing I 
truly wish to convey to you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Never neglecting daily efforts, and purely 
pursuing victory to the point of earnestly 
praying for it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-san, you're already a protagonist 
in my eyes! If I was able to help, I 
couldn't be happier!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Ah, um, I'm so happy! Really, really 
happy...
choice_data_list: You're one of the protagonists too!
You're one of the protagonists too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Ah, um, I'm so happy! Really, really 
happy...
choice_data_list: You're one of the protagonists too!
You're one of the protagonists too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...I was only speaking my mind honestly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Yes. Well then, excuse me. Let's 
go eat ramen together next time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes... Next time... Next time?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaa~~! Ah, no way?! An invite to ramen 
from my faveee!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because the image of her blowing to cool 
her food and fogging up her glasses is 
still so fresh in my mind...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"To think I get to be blessed with the 
sight of her eating ramen again... M-M-My 
drool is, d-d-drooooling everywhere~~ 
sluuuurp!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Agnes Digital's love for 
Umamusume exploded just as usual...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeh?! N-N-No way! I'm just a side 
character compared to the other 
Umamusume—practically Passerby Z!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I don't really stand out much either. 
Hehe... maybe we're kindred spirits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyo!? T-Two of a kind?! N-N-N-No way, 
that's far too much praise for meee!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! Saying we're similar must 
be such a nuisance to you, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, being able to share these 
feelings makes me so happy I could...!? 
Ababababa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Assaulted by a whirlwind of emotions, 
Agnes Digital completely lost her 
sanity...!
